title: Coulthart's changing sources on the drone flyovers

tellings.quote: you know, I remember when those the Chinese drones were flying over and he was always like, "My sources say this and my sources say that and he's so confident about sources and then his sources keep changing the story still."

plain: During the 2024 wave of drone sightings over the United States, the journalist Ross Coulthart is said to have spoken confidently about what his sources told him while those sources kept changing their story. The musician Flying Lotus tells Michels this from following Coulthart's reporting: "he's so confident about sources and then his sources keep changing the story." The point is that a well-known UFO reporter's inside information may be less steady than it sounds.
